notes.notes:
You are no longer required to click the Peach when your timer runs out. Skins now auto drop the moment your timer hits zero!
 Fixed Inventory and Daily UIs not loading the first time you open them after starting the game
 Halloween Event is over and the Halloween skins are no longer droppable

notes.title: October 27th Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added Dailies:

 There's a new Daily Menu ("D" keyboard shortcut; "Select/Options" for controller) which presents you with a small Peach Tree that you have to water every day for 7 days!
  On the 7th day, when the tree has fully grown and you water it again - you get a random Peach Skin (Normal or Common rarity, 50% chance for either) and the tree reverts back to a small sapling
 You can only water the tree once per day (even if you forget to water it - you don't lose your progress)
 The daily menu features a number of different states (backgrounds):

 Normal Day (40% chance) - no effects
 Rainy Day (40% chance) - you don't need to water your tree, it gets watered automatically when you open the Daily Menu
 Sunny Day (20% chance) - you get +1 to your day counter, which allows you to get +2 to your day counter if you also water

 If you enter the game after 7 PM (UTC) you will be presented with the night variants of the backgrounds:

 Normal Night (40% chance) - no effects
 Rainy Night (40% chance) - same as Rainy Day
 Starry Night (20% chance) - if you are at your 7th day and water the tree to get your skin, instead of getting a random Normal or Common skin, you get the special Star Peach skin, which can only be acquired through the daily


 Fixed UI scaling issue when in Windowed mode and resizing the window

 Added new Peach Skins:

 Star Peach - acquired only through Daily when Starry Night is visible

notes.title: September 23rd Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added 16 New Achievements:

 Leveling Achievements:

 First Taste - You've reached level 5 and unlocked your first Special Peach - taste the Copper!
 Silver Lining - You've leveled up to 10 and claimed the shimmering Silver Peach. Keep going!
 Golden Harvest - At level 15, you've struck gold! The Golden Peach is now yours to admire.
 Diamond Master - You've reached the pinnacle - level 20! The elusive Diamond Peach is now in your collection.

 Skin Collector Achievements:

 Dressing Up! - You're just getting started. 5 skins down, many more to go!
 Fashion Fanatic - You've got an eye for style! 10 skins in the closet!
 Wardrobe Wizard - 25 skins? You're practically a fashionista!
 Outfit Overload - 50 skins collected! You're setting trends now!
 Skin Collector Supreme - A century of skins. You've officially unlocked legendary style status!

 Mini Peach Achievements:

 Peach Snatcher - Your first Mini Peach! There's no going back now!
 You Stupid? 21 - 9 + 10 = 21! You've grabbed 21 Mini Peaches like a pro!
 Peach Collector - You're becoming a Mini Peach hoarder with 50 snatches!
 Peach Enthusiast - 100 Mini Peach down! Your dedication to peach-clicking is unmatched!
 Blink And You'll Miss It - Oops! Looks like your fingers need some practice - 5 Mini Peaches missed!
 Peach Hunter - Your aim is on point! 10 Mini Peaches in a row, no misses!
 Master of Peaches - The perfect balance of time and XP. You've mastered the Mini Peach game!
 Time Traveler - You've bent time itself, shaving off a solid 30 minutes from your Drop Timer!


 Added skin counts to each Skin in the in-game Inventory
 Added 4 new Peach Skins:

 Annoying Peach (Normal)
 Boké Pall Peach (Rare)
 Cube Peach (Rare)
 Bobr Peach (Ultra Rare)

 Added new Cursors with Sound Effects to the Item Shop! Once bought - these appear in your in-game Inventory. These are purely cosmetic and cost a few cents. Get them to spice up your Peach Smacking Experience™!
 Added a Reset Cursor button to the Settings Menu to reset your cursor to normal
 Added a new Stats Window to the game to keep track of your Mini Peach stats for the Mini Peach Achievements. You can open it with the "O" hotkey on your keyboard or "Square" (PS Controller) / "X" (Xbox Controller).

notes.title: September 8th Update Notes
notes.notes:

notes.title: September 7th Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added a Sort Inventory button to stack same skins for a nicer Inventory
 Added hotkeys for Inventory (I) and Settings (S) as well as the option to navigate Inventory pages with the Arrow keys
 Added new achievement (1,000,000 Clicks)
 Added new option to change game background if the achievement for it is unlocked (Settings window)
 Added Controller Support:

 "X" or "A" to smack Peach
 Triggers to smack Peach
 "Triangle" or "Y" to open Inventory
 "B" or "O" to close/exit
 "Options" or "Start" to open Settings
 "D-pad" and Analog Sticks for navigation

 Added a Leveling System:

 You get XP every time you smack the Peach
 On the bottom of the screen, below the CPS, there is an XP Bar which shows you how much XP you currently have, what Level you are on and how much you need to Level Up!
 Every 5 levels you get a Special Peach, which can only be acquired by Leveling Up!

 Level 5 - Copper Peach
 Level 10 - Silver Peach
 Level 15 - Gold Peach
 Level 20 (Max Level) - Diamond Peach

 These 4 Peaches can be traded and sold, but there is no other way to get them (unless you buy them from someone on the Marketplace of course)

 Added Mini Peaches:

 Every 15 minutes, a random chance roll is performed, which has a 50% chance to spawn a Mini Peach. This means that if you're really lucky - you can get a total of 12 Mini Peaches in the timespan of 3 hours (the time required for a skin drop). If you get a lucky roll - another roll is performed and there's a 50/50 chance if you'll get a Time Peach or an XP Peach. It will stay on your screen for 15 seconds. If you manage to click the Mini Peach before it disappears, you get the following:

 Time Peach - minimum 15 to maximum 30 minutes shaved off your Drop Timer
 XP Peach - minimum 1000 to maximum 2000 XP added to your Level

notes.title: August 24th Update Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue with skins not dropping for some people!
- Due to popular demand, we made the game work in idle mode! That means that you can leave it running in the background and the Drop Timer will keep going down!
It's important to note that you need to click the Peach at least ONCE when the timer is at zero in order to get your drop!
- Changed the flashing light on background change to a smooth fade
- Added a Settings menu, where you can change your game Resolution, adjust volume settings and switch between Fullscreen and Windowed
- Changed the drop pool to 3 hours to stimulate the skin prices, as they won't be dropping as often anymore!

We value your feedback, our Sweet Peaches, so make sure to let us know about any and all bugs and/or suggestions you have for the game! You can also join our official Discord Server to stay in touch with us and all other Peaches!
We are here to listen to all your feedback and make Peach Clicker better, together! 🤗🍑
